name: Spec change

title: "spec: "
labels: spec-change
---

## Problem

What the current spec gets wrong, leaves ambiguous, or does not cover. Link
the section(s): `docs/spec.md#…`.

## Proposed normative text

The exact MUST / SHOULD / MAY wording you want in `docs/spec.md`.

## Affected sections

- `docs/spec.md` §…
- Guides that restate it (`docs/provider.md`, `docs/personal-agent.md`): …

## Breaking?

- [ ] No — existing conformant Providers and personal agents stay conformant.
- [ ] Yes — describe what breaks and how implementers migrate.
